TESLA.NAME: Tesla
TESLA.DESCRIPTION: Tesla vehicles via the Tesla Fleet API

API_URL.NAME: Fleet API URL
API_URL.DESCRIPTION: Region of the account: EU https://fleet-api.prd.eu.vn.cloud.tesla.com, North America/Asia-Pacific https://fleet-api.prd.na.vn.cloud.tesla.com, China https://fleet-api.prd.cn.vn.cloud.tesla.cn

CLIENT_ID.NAME: Client ID
CLIENT_ID.DESCRIPTION: Client ID of your application on developer.tesla.com

REFRESH_TOKEN.NAME: Refresh token
REFRESH_TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: OAuth refresh token (scope offline_access vehicle_device_data vehicle_cmds vehicle_charging_cmds). Tesla replaces it on every use, the driver keeps the newest one

COMMAND_URL.NAME: Command proxy URL
COMMAND_URL.DESCRIPTION: Optional. Vehicles built since 2021 only accept signed commands: run Tesla's vehicle-command proxy (tesla-http-proxy) and enter its URL here. Empty = commands go to the Fleet API directly

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: Fleet API calls are billed by Tesla. Data is only requested while a vehicle is online, polling does not wake it

CHARGING.NAME: Charging
CHARGING.DESCRIPTION: Write true to start and false to stop charging

CHARGE_PORT_OPEN.NAME: Charge port open
CHARGE_PORT_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Write true to open and false to close the charge port

CLIMATE.NAME: Climate
CLIMATE.DESCRIPTION: Write true to start and false to stop climate control

LOCKED.NAME: Locked
LOCKED.DESCRIPTION: Write true to lock and false to unlock

WAKE.NAME: Wake up
WAKE.DESCRIPTION: Write any value to wake the vehicle

FLASH_LIGHTS.NAME: Flash lights
FLASH_LIGHTS.DESCRIPTION: Write true to flash the lights

HONK.NAME: Honk
HONK.DESCRIPTION: Write true to honk the horn
